notes.title: Update version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Updated to fix some bugs, add some things, and some other things that I can't remember.
 This is just a small update to make the game more user-friendly and enjoyable.
 
Logic - Keypad will also participate in the upcoming Steam Fuzzle Fest promotion from April 24th to May 1st, so you can expect a better discount then.

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
The game has ended its Early Access and will be released in the full version on March 11th

 All levels, puzzles, codes, and hints have been fully and meticulously updated and completed in the game.
 Optimized performance for PC, fixed any image and sound conflicts, and improved loading times for each level.
Players can enable all settings in Ultra mode for the best experience.
 The game price will remain the same after the end of the Early Access phase.
You can purchase the game at any time or wishlist and wait for upcoming discounts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425014/df5bd3213c8f6fcb4a072c199d9387bf68c043fc.png

Thank you very much to the players who have accompanied the game during the Early Access phase.

notes.title: Game release - 24/2
notes.notes:
Game is scheduled to launch on February 24th

Although in the Early Access stage, the game is almost complete and players can fully experience it.
I will maintain this for a short period of time to update, modify, and add new ideas (if any).

This is my first game on Steam, and I hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Deactivate Demo version
notes.notes:
Deactivate Demo version. The Demo has done its job well when it comes to player feedback and reviews.
To focus on game development, the Demo will be paused to make further improvements as the development process has changed significantly from the original plan.

Updated a few images and game introduction videos with the story written in 30 minutes.
